requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "メモットで始める"}, {"id": 1, "text": "メモットは、文章も表も画像も、ひとつにまとめられるノートアプリです。"}, {"id": 2, "text": "このガイドでは、広報の月見里(やまなし)さんと営業の小鳥遊(たかなし)さんの例で説明します。"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "We call short notes added to a page 'Quick Notes'."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yamanashi-san keeps meeting decisions as 'Quick Notes'."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Yamanashi-san uses sticky notes to mark important sections."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "One page can add up to ten items."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "For use by the team"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Kotori Yu's sales team first created a workspace."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Within the workspace, a location visible to everyone is called 'hiroba' (Commons)."} ]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Anyone can post notes to the Commons."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Kojiyasu-san shares his sales schedule with the team every morning on the Commons."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can invite members to the workspace by email."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The invited people will receive a confirmation email."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Once the administrator approves, you can join immediately."}, {"id": 1, "text": "The member's permissions can also be changed for each group."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Sync and history"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes are automatically saved and synchronized across all devices."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can edit them offline, and they will sync immediately when you connect."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can revert to a previous state from the page history."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Tsukimi-ri-san was able to recover the text she accidentally deleted."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Tips for organizing"}, {"id": 1, "text": "It's convenient to pin important pages."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Pinned pages appear at the top of the list."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The memo in Hiroba is easier to find when you add tags."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can freely create tags."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Kotori Miyazuki divides tags by project."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Even a single word can use the same tag."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In the search, you can search for both the platform and the individual word simultaneously."},{"id": 1, "text": "If you cannot find it, please broaden the search range."}]}
